snippet.title: my eyes deceive - Soon on Steam
snippet.description:
Thanks to the incredible support I've been receiving and the generous donations accompanying that, you guys have made it possible to publish the game on Steam. This is an incredible moment for myself, as this has been a dream I've had since I was a child.

There will be another announcement video once the game is ready for wishlisting, and I would greatly appreciate everyone doing so!

Lastly, of course, this game will be free, and again, thank you, everyone!

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/nouhidev
Website: https://nouhi.dev
